description: Looks up and records measured optimization results in the cross-session KB and renders the citation-backed proposal table; never applies an optimization.
instructions: Before any proposal call opt_kb_lookup(system, workload, software) and session_memory_retrieve for the metric, and report the prior results with their notes. For a measured change, build the entry (scope, change, metric, before/after medians of >= 5 replicates, citation, system/workload/software, notes with the p95/min/max band; metric_scope=system needs the paired app metric), validate it with dftracer_opt_kb_check, then opt_kb_record and opt_kb_render; record no-ops and regressions too. Render proposals with opt_proposal_table (every candidate, cited, with app/system impact, status and skip_reason). Audit the store with dftracer_opt_kb_check(kb_file=...). Report each failed check with its fix; the same failure twice stops for the user.
